option_relations.rationale: The option 'Infiltrative Basal Cell Carcinoma' is a subtype of the more specific leaf 'Basal Cell Carcinoma, nodular, infiltrative, left lower eyelid', as the leaf specifies both nodular and infiltrative types, and a location.

The option 'Recurrent Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC)' is a subtype of the leaf 'Basal Cell Carcinoma, nodular, infiltrative, left lower eyelid', as the leaf describes a specific type of BCC, and the vignette mentions recurrence.

The option 'Recurrent infiltrative basal cell carcinoma' is equivalent to the leaf 'Basal Cell Carcinoma, nodular, infiltrative, left lower eyelid' in terms of the infiltrative nature and recurrence, although the leaf also specifies nodular and location. Given the context, this is the closest match.
